Meet the God
of This Universe.

Whether you've found your way back to me or you're discovering me for the first time — welcome. I'm Fern.

Come a little closer ↓
01 · The person behind the worlds

I'm not one thing.
I never intended to be.

I'm a builder, a designer, a strategist, and a relentlessly curious mind.

I see possibilities where other people see blank space. Sometimes they become websites. Sometimes they become intelligent systems, new businesses, or strange little universes that only existed in my imagination yesterday.

I don't believe creativity and intelligence belong in separate rooms. My work lives where the two collide — where meticulous logic makes room for something wildly original.

I / RESILIENCE

I rebuild.

I've learned that beginning again isn't the opposite of progress. Sometimes it's the most powerful proof of it.

II / DETERMINATION

I follow through.

An idea is only the beginning. I want to give it structure, purpose, and a place in the real world.

III / AMBITION

I keep growing.

I don't want to be defined by one skill, one title, or one finished project. I want to keep discovering what else I can build.

“I am not interested in fitting into the world as it is. I'm interested in seeing what it could become.”

Fern · Creator of these worlds

02 · The worlds I've begun

Ideas made tangible.

Sites by Fern is my creative studio. Soren explores business intelligence. Ostara explores human connection with AI. Each project starts differently, but all of them come from the same instinct: imagine, learn, build, evolve.
